p: came up: After that Saul was chosen king: for fear of whom they asked a king, as in 1Sa 12:12.
right eyes: This declares that the closer the tyrants are to their destruction, the more cruel they are.
came upon Saul when he heard: God gave him the spirit of strength and courage to go against this tyrant.
Samuel: He adds Samuel because Saul was not yet approved by all.
they said unto the messengers that: Meaning, Saul and Samuel.
you: That is, to the Ammonites, concealing that they had hope of aid.
Who is he that said: By this victory the Lord won the hearts of the people to Saul.
put to death this day: By showing mercy he thought to overcome their malice.
peace offerings before the LORD: In sign of thanksgiving for the victory.
